title: Evaluating AI Group Fairness: a Fuzzy Logic Perspective
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper proposes a theoretical framework for evaluating group fairness using fuzzy logic, not a specific benchmark measuring faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith; its focus is on a general logical framework for evaluating group fairness with examples pertaining to gender and race.
